'''Triggerbirds''' were native to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where they lived in symbiosis with [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]]. The [[Bird/Legends|birds]] lived in the gas creatures' tentacles for shelter and ate small creatures.
